question: Suppose the internal bisectors of the angles of a quadrilateral form another quadrilateral. Then the sum of the cosines of the angles of the second quadrilateral

options.A: is a constant independent of the first quadrilateral
options.B: always equals the sum of the sines of the angles of the first quadrilateral
options.C: always equals the sum of the cosines of the angles of the first quadrilateral
options.D: depends on the angles as well as the sides of the first quadrilateral

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level
